    "ame, CONCAT(LEFT(tblAccAcc_GLAccounts.glAccountNumber,3),\"-\", RIGHT(tblAccAcc_"
    "GLAccounts.glAccountNumber,3) ,\" \",tblAccAcc_GLAccounts.glAccountName) AS glAc"
    "countNumber, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.documentID, tblAccGL_Postings.postingName,  tb"
    "lAccGL_Postings.fiscalDate, \015\012tblAccGL_PostingSubs.creditAmount, \015\012t"
    "blAccGL_PostingSubs.debitAmount, \015\012tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingDescription"
    ", name1, name2\015\012FROM (((tblAccGL_Postings INNER JOIN tblAccGL_PostingSubs "
    "ON tblAccGL_Postings.postingID = tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingID) INNER JOIN tblS"
    "hrdDB_Tables ON tblAccGL_Postings.parentTableID = tblShrdDB_Tables.tableID) INNE"
    "R JOIN tblAccAcc_GLAccounts ON tblAccGL_PostingSubs.GLAccountID = tblAccAcc_GLAc"
    "counts.GLAccountID) INNER JOIN tblPtr_Partners ON tblAccGL_PostingSubs.partnerID"
    " = tblPtr_Partners.partnerID\015\012WHERE  (tblAccGL_Postings.companyID=1004) AN"
    "D  (LEFT(tblAccAcc_GLAccounts.glAccountNumber,2)='22') AND  (tblAccGL_Postings.f"

dbMemo "SQL" ="SELECT\015\012Q.GLAccountID, Q.glAccountNumber, Q.partnerName, Q.countryID, Q.pa"

    "reDocPayments)  AS preDocPayments,\015\012Q.preDocAm+IF(ISNULL(Q.preDocPayments)"
    ",0,Q.preDocPayments) AS preDocBalance,\015\012Q.rpDocAm,\015\012Q.rpPayments,\015"
    "\012Q.rpBalance,\015\012Q.notAssignedPayments,\015\012Q.totalPayments\015\012FRO"
    "M\015\012(\015\012    SELECT\015\012    tblAccAcc_CountryGroupGLAccounts.receiva"
    "blesGLAccountID AS GLAccountID,\015\012    tblAccAcc_GLAccounts.glAccountNumber,"
    "\015\012    CONCAT_WS(' ', tblPtr_Partners.name1, tblPtr_Partners.name2, tblPtr_"
    "Partners.name3) AS partnerName,\015\012    tblPtr_Partners.partnerID,\015\012   "
    " tblPtr_Partners.countryID,\015\012    0 AS isLInked,\015\012    (\015\012      "
    "  SELECT \015\012         ROUND(100 * SUM(qty *(tblggInv1sub.salesPrice - tblggI"
    "nv1sub.salesDiscount - tblggInv1sub.salesCommission) *(1 - `tblggInv1`.salesInvo"
    "iceDiscount )),0)\015\012         FROM  \015\012                `MV`.`tblTourSal"
    "es_ggInvoices` `tblggInv1` JOIN `MV`.`tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSubs` `tblggInv1sub`"
    " ON `MV`.`tblggInv1sub`.`ggInvoiceID` = `tblggInv1`.`ggInvoiceID`\015\012    WHE"

============== START FILE: qryAccARAP_SumsSub_PI.txt ==============

dbMemo "SQL" ="SELECT  \015\012GLAccountID,\015\012Q.glAccountNumber,\015\012Q.partnerName,\015"
    "\012Q.partnerID,\015\012 Q.countryID,\015\0120 AS isLInked,\015\012Q.preDocAm,\015"
    "\012IF(ISNULL(Q.preDocPayments),0,Q.preDocPayments) AS preDocPayments,\015\012Q."
    "preDocAm+IF(ISNULL(Q.preDocPayments),0,Q.preDocPayments) AS preDocBalance ,\015\012"
    "0 AS rpDocAm,\015\0120 AS rpPayments,\015\0120 AS rpBalance,\015\0120 AS notAssi"
    "gnedPayments,\015\0120 AS totalPayments\015\012FROM\015\012(\015\012SELECT\015\012"
    "    tblAccAcc_CountryGroupGLAccounts.payablesGLAccountID AS GLAccountID,\015\012"
    "    tblAccAcc_GLAccounts.glAccountNumber,\015\012    CONCAT_WS( ' ', tblPtr_Part"
    "ners.name1, tblPtr_Partners.name2,   tblPtr_Partners.name3 ) AS partnerName,\015"
    "\012    tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices.partnerID,\015\012    tblPtr_Partners.country"
    "ID,\015\012    ROUND( -100 * SUM(            tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices.purchase"
    "InvoiceAmount        )    ) AS preDocAm,\015\012(\015\012SELECT\015\012      rou"
    "nd(100 * sum(`MV`.`tblAccGL_PostingSubs`.`debitAmount`-`MV`.`tblAccGL_PostingSub"
    "s`.`creditAmount` ),0) AS `preDocPayments` \015\012FROM \015\012        `MV`.`tb"
    "lDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices` `tblPI` INNER JOIN `MV`.`tblAccGL_PostingSubs` on `MV`"
    ".`tblAccGL_PostingSubs`.`documentID` = `tblPI`.`purchaseInvoiceID`\015\012WHERE "
    "`tblPI`.`companyID` =1002 AND (tblPI.documentStatusID=2) AND `tblPI`.`partnerID`"
    "=tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices.partnerID AND  (DATE_FORMAT(tblPI.purchaseInvoiceDat"
    "e,    '%Y%m'  ) BETWEEN 200001 AND 205012)\015\012GROUP BY `tblPI`.`partnerID`\015"
    "\012)  as preDocPayments\015\012FROM\015\012       (  (   (      (         (\015"
    "\012                       tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices\015\012                INN"
    "ER JOIN tblPtr_Partners ON tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices.partnerID = tblPtr_Partner"
    "s.partnerID                )\015\012            INNER JOIN tblShrdGeo_Countries "
    "ON tblPtr_Partners.countryID = tblShrdGeo_Countries.countryID            )\015\012"
    "        INNER JOIN tblShrdGeo_CountryGroups ON tblShrdGeo_Countries.countryGroup"
    "ID = tblShrdGeo_CountryGroups.countryGroupID        )\015\012        INNER JOIN "
    "tblAccAcc_CountryGroupGLAccounts ON tblShrdGeo_CountryGroups.countryGroupID = tb"

dbMemo "SQL" ="SELECT\015\012Q.GLAccountID,\015\012Q.GLAccName,\015\012Q.bpName,\015\012Q.L1,\015"
    "\012Q.L2,\015\012Q.L3,\015\012Sum(Q.opDb) as opDb,\015\012Sum(Q.opCr) as opCr,\015"
    "\012Sum(Q.trDb) As trDb,\015\012Sum(Q.trCr) As trCr,\015\012Sum(IF(Q.trCr-Q.trDb"
    "<0,Q.trDb-Q.trCr,0)) as netTrDb,\015\012Sum(IF(Q.trCr-Q.trDb>0,Q.trCr-Q.trDb,0))"
    " as netTrCr,\015\012Sum(Q.totalDb) as totalDb,\015\012Sum(Q.totalCr) As totalCr,"
    "\015\012Sum(Q.totalBalance) As totalBalance,\015\012Q.balanceSign,\015\012IF((Q."
    "balanceSign=Sign(Sum(totalBalance))) Or (Sign(Sum(totalBalance))=0),1,2) as seq,"
    "\015\0120 as excludeFromFS\015\012\015\012FROM\015\012(\015\012SELECT \015\012tb"
    "lAccGL_PostingSubs.GLAccountID, \015\012qryAccAcc_GLAccounts1.GLAccName AS GLAcc"
    "Name, \015\012If(qryAccAcc_GLAccounts1.showBP<>0, CONCAT_WS(\" \", tblPtr_Partne"
    "rs.name1, tblPtr_Partners.name2, tblPtr_Partners.name3) ,Null) AS bpName,  \015\012"
    "qryAccAcc_GLAccounts1.L1, \015\012qryAccAcc_GLAccounts1.L2, \015\012qryAccAcc_GL"
    "Accounts1.L3, \015\012Cast(Sum(If(fiscalMonth<=0,debitAmount,0)) AS Double) AS o"
    "pDb, \015\012Cast(Sum(If(fiscalMonth<=0,creditAmount,0)) AS Double) AS opCr, \015"
    "\012Cast(Sum(If(fiscalMonth<=0,-debitAmount+creditAmount, 0)) AS Double) AS opTo"
    "talBalance,\015\012Cast(Sum(If(fiscalMonth > 0, debitAmount, 0)) AS Double) AS t"
    "rDb, \015\012Cast(Sum(If(fiscalMonth > 0, creditAmount, 0)) AS Double) AS trCr, "
    "\015\012Cast(IF(Sum(debitAmount-creditAmount)>0, Sum(debitAmount-creditAmount),0"
    ") AS Double)  AS totalDb, \015\012Cast(IF(Sum(creditAmount-debitAmount)>0, Sum(c"
    "reditAmount-debitAmount),0) AS Double)  AS totalCr,  \015\012Cast(Sum(-debitAmou"
    "nt+creditAmount) AS Double) AS totalBalance,\015\012qryAccAcc_GLAccounts1.balanc"
    "eSign\015\012\015\012FROM \015\012tblAccGL_Postings \015\012INNER JOIN tblAccGL_"
    "PostingSubs ON tblAccGL_Postings.postingID = tblAccGL_PostingSubs.postingID\015\012"
    "LEFT JOIN tblPtr_Partners ON tblAccGL_PostingSubs.partnerID = tblPtr_Partners.pa"
    "rtnerID \015\012INNER JOIN qryAccAcc_GLAccounts1 ON tblAccGL_PostingSubs.GLAccou"
    "ntID = qryAccAcc_GLAccounts1.GLAccountID\015\012WHERE (tblAccGL_Postings.company"
    "ID=1004) AND (tblAccGL_Postings.fiscalYear=2024) AND  (tblAccGL_PostingSubs.fisc"
    "alMonth >=0)   AND  (tblAccGL_PostingSubs.fiscalMonth <=13)  AND qryAccAcc_GLAcc"
    "ounts1.excludeFromFS=0\015\012GROUP BY tblAccGL_PostingSubs.GLAccountID, IF(qryA"
    "ccAcc_GLAccounts1.isBSAccount<>1,0,IF(IsNull(tblAccGL_PostingSubs.partnerID) Or "
    "(qryAccAcc_GLAccounts1.considerPartner=0),0, tblAccGL_PostingSubs.partnerID)) \015"
    "\012\015\012) Q\015\012GROUP BY Q.GLAccountID, Q.bpName, IF(balanceSign=-1, IF(S"
    "IGN(totalBalance)<=0,-1,1), IF(SIGN(totalBalance)>=0,1,-1))\015\012ORDER BY Q.GL"
    "AccName;"

dbMemo "SQL" ="SELECT tblCmpy_Companies.cmpyName, CONCAT_WS(' ',tblPtr_Partners.name1,tblPtr_Pa"
    "rtners.name2) AS empName, tblPtr_Partners.partnerID, DATE(jobStart) AS dt,\015\012"
    "SUM(IF(ISNULL(tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock.deletedAt),Round(TIMESTAMPDIFF(Second,jo"
    "bStart,jobEnd)/36),0)) AS noOfHours_100, \015\012SUM(IF(tblEmpTime_DailyTimecloc"
    "k.costCenterID=101,IF(ISNULL(tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock.deletedAt),Round(TIMESTAM"
    "PDIFF(Second,jobStart,jobEnd)/36),0) ,0)) AS noOfHoursJP_100,\015\012SUM(IF(tblE"
    "mpTime_DailyTimeclock.costCenterID<>101,IF(ISNULL(tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock.dele"
    "tedAt),Round(TIMESTAMPDIFF(Second,jobStart,jobEnd)/36),0) ,0)) AS noOfHoursDBD_1"
    "00,\015\012MIN(1) AS m01, MIN(11) AS m02, Month(jobStart) AS mnth, Year(jobStart"
    ") AS yr, tblPtr_Partners.name1, tblPtr_Partners.name2\015\012FROM ((((tblEmpTime"
    "_DailyTimeclock INNER JOIN (tblPtr_Partners INNER JOIN tblPtr_PartnersCmpys ON t"
    "blPtr_Partners.partnerID = tblPtr_PartnersCmpys.partnerID) ON tblEmpTime_DailyTi"
    "meclock.employmentID = tblPtr_PartnersCmpys.partnerCmpyID) LEFT JOIN tblCmpy_Cos"
    "tCenters ON tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock.costCenterID = tblCmpy_CostCenters.costCen"
    "terID) INNER JOIN tblCmpy_Companies ON tblPtr_PartnersCmpys.companyID = tblCmpy_"
    "Companies.companyID) LEFT JOIN tblEmp_Jobs ON tblEmpTime_DailyTimeclock.jobID = "
    "tblEmp_Jobs.jobID) LEFT JOIN tblCmpyCat_Departments ON tblEmp_Jobs.departmentID "

dbMemo "SQL" ="SELECT If(isFood=1,\"1 - hrana\",If(isBeverage=1,\"2 - pijaca\",\"3 - ostalo\"))"
    " AS groupGroup,  tblProdCat_ProductGroups_1.productGroup1Name, tblProdCat_Produc"
    "tGroups.productGroupName, tblProdCat_Products.productName, tblProdCat_Products.s"
    "alesPrice, tblProdCat_Products.baseUnitPurchasePrice, If(tblProdCat_Products.sal"
    "esPrice<>0,baseUnitPurchasePrice/(tblProdCat_Products.salesPrice/(1+tblProdCat_P"
    "roducts.vatRateID/10000)),Null) AS WE, Round(100*Sum(tblCRSales_crInvoiceDetails"
    ".qty)) AS totalQtyx, Round(100*Sum((1-discount)*qty*tblCRSales_crInvoiceDetails."

dbMemo "SQL" ="SELECT\015\012piID, number, supplier, amount,  diffPI_Sub, diffPI_links, fiscalY"
    "ear,  Month, DDVO, noOfLinks, countryID\015\012\015\012FROM\015\012(\015\012SELE"
    "CT \015\012tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices.purchaseInvoiceID as piID, tblDocAcc_Purch"
    "aseInvoices.purchaseInvoiceNumber as number, CONCAT_WS(\" \",tblPtr_Partners.nam"
    "e1, tblPtr_Partners.name2) as supplier, \015\012tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices.purch"
    "aseInvoiceAmount as amount, \015\012\015\012\015\012   tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoice"
    "s.purchaseInvoiceAmount -\015\012   COALESCE(\015\012      (\015\012       SELEC"
    "T Sum(tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs.purchaseInvoiceSubAmount) AS SumOfpurchaseIn"
    "voiceSubAmount\015\012       FROM tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs\015\012       WH"
    "ERE tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs.`purchaseInvoiceID` = `MV`.`tblDocAcc_Purchase"
    "Invoices`.`purchaseInvoiceID` AND IsNull(tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs.`partnerI"
    "D`)\015\012       GROUP BY tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs.purchaseInvoiceID\015\012"
    "\015\012      )\015\012        ,0) As diffPI_Sub,\015\012\015\012  tblDocAcc_Pur"
    "chaseInvoices.purchaseInvoiceAmount -\015\012   COALESCE(\015\012      (\015\012"
    "       SELECT Sum(tblTourPurchase_PurchaseSalesLinks.purchaseLinkAmount)\015\012"
    "       FROM tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs INNER JOIN tblTourPurchase_PurchaseSal"
    "esLinks ON tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs.purchaseInvoiceSubID = tblTourPurchase_"
    "PurchaseSalesLinks.purchaseInvoiceSubID\015\012       WHERE tblDocAcc_PurchaseIn"
    "voiceSubs.`purchaseInvoiceID` = `MV`.`tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices`.`purchaseInvoi"
    "ceID`\015\012       GROUP BY tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs.purchaseInvoiceID\015"
    "\012      )\015\012        ,0) As diffPI_Links,\015\012\015\012tblDocAcc_Purchas"
    "eInvoices.fiscalYear, \015\012CONCAT(Min(DATE_FORMAT(tblTourSales_ggInvoices.ser"
    "viceLastDate, '%Y.%m')),\"-\", Max(DATE_FORMAT(tblTourSales_ggInvoices.serviceLa"
    "stDate, '%Y.%m'))) AS Month,\015\012\015\012(\015\012  SELECT \015\012    COUNT("
    "tblAccVat_DDVODetails.purchaseSalesLinkID)\015\012    FROM tblDocAcc_PurchaseInv"
    "oices PI \015\012    INNER JOIN tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs PIS ON PI.purchase"
    "InvoiceID = PIS.purchaseInvoiceID \015\012    INNER JOIN tblTourPurchase_Purchas"
    "eSalesLinks PSL ON PIS.purchaseInvoicesubID = PSL.purchaseInvoiceSubID \015\012 "
    "   INNER JOIN tblAccVat_DDVODetails ON tblAccVat_DDVODetails.purchaseSalesLinkID"
    " = PSL.purchaseSalesLinkID \015\012    WHERE tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices.purchase"
    "InvoiceID = PI.purchaseInvoiceID\015\012) AS DDVO,\015\012\015\012(\015\012  SEL"
    "ECT \015\012    COUNT(PSL.purchaseSalesLinkID)\015\012    FROM tblDocAcc_Purchas"
    "eInvoices PI \015\012    INNER JOIN tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoiceSubs PIS ON PI.purc"
    "haseInvoiceID = PIS.purchaseInvoiceID \015\012    INNER JOIN tblTourPurchase_Pur"
    "chaseSalesLinks PSL ON PIS.purchaseInvoicesubID = PSL.purchaseInvoiceSubID \015\012"
    "    WHERE tblDocAcc_PurchaseInvoices.purchaseInvoiceID = PI.purchaseInvoiceID\015"

    "nt-salesCommission)),2),12,\" \") as  total\015\012from tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSu"
    "bs\015\012left join tblTourSales_Bookings on tblTourSales_Bookings.bookingID=tbl"
    "TourSales_ggInvoiceSubs.bookingID\015\012left join tblTourB_BundleProducts on tb"
    "lTourB_BundleProducts.productID=tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSubs.productID\015\012left"
    " join tblTourB_Bundles on tblTourB_Bundles.bundleID=tblTourB_BundleProducts.bund"
    "leID\015\012where tblTourSales_Bookings.bookingStatus=1\015\012and tblTourSales_"
    "Bookings.confirmedAt is not null\015\012and tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSubs.partnerCo"
    "mpanyID is null\015\012and tblTourSales_Bookings.bookedAt>'2021-06-30'\015\012an"
    "d tblTourSales_Bookings.bookedAt<'2022-10-01'\015\012group by tblTourB_Bundles.x"
    "mlPartner\015\012"

    "es \015\012     INNER JOIN tblPtr_Partners ON tblTourSales_ggInvoices.partnerID "
    "= tblPtr_Partners.partnerID\015\012     INNER JOIN tblShrdGeo_Countries ON tblPt"
    "r_Partners.countryID = tblShrdGeo_Countries.countryID\015\012     INNER JOIN tbl"
    "ShrdGeo_CountryGroups ON tblShrdGeo_Countries.countryGroupID = tblShrdGeo_Countr"
    "yGroups.countryGroupID\015\012     INNER JOIN tblAccAcc_CountryGroupGLAccounts O"
    "N tblShrdGeo_CountryGroups.countryGroupID = tblAccAcc_CountryGroupGLAccounts.cou"
    "ntryGroupID\015\012\015\012WHERE (tblTourSales_ggInvoices.companyID=11 OR tblTou"
    "rSales_ggInvoices.company1ID=11)\015\012     AND (tblTourSales_ggInvoices.docume"
    "ntStatusID=3) \015\012     AND (tblTourSales_ggInvoices.documentTypeID=2 OR tblT"
    "ourSales_ggInvoices.documentTypeID=3) \015\012     AND (Not tblTourSales_ggInvoi"
    "ces.serviceLastDate Is Null) \015\012     AND (tblTourSales_ggInvoices.invoiceDa"
    "te Is Not Null) \015\012     AND (Not tblTourSales_ggInvoices.costCenterID Is Nu"
    "ll) \015\012     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT postingID FROM  tblAccGL_Postings WHERE "
    "(tblTourSales_ggInvoices.ggInvoiceID = tblAccGL_Postings.parentID) AND (tblAccGL"
    "_Postings.parentTableID=130))\015\012     AND (SELECT SUM((1-tblTourSales_ggInvo"
    "ices.salesInvoiceDiscount/100)*tblTourSales_ggInvoiceSubs.qty*(tblTourSales_ggIn"
